en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a European riverside town. Dominating the scene is a tall clock‑towered building with ornate neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance features, likely a town hall, standing beside a river with its full reflection visible in the calm water. A small bridge crosses the river in front of the main building. Surrounding it are lower, 19th‑century style townhouses and industrial-looking structures, with a smokestack in the background and gently wooded hills behind the town. The sky is bright, trees are bare or sparse, and there are no cars visible. The upper right corner of the image is irregularly cut, as if from an old negative or print. No legible text appears on the image.
